messages:
jia: Heads up — onboarding request for new model `hermes-13b-long` (opt long-context variant). Need a quantization plan + calibration checklist. Goal: get a cost-friendly int8 path, fp8 fallback for convo quality, and a gguf artifact for offline customers. Thoughts? :eyes:

margaret: +1. Can we start with a length-aware calibration sweep? this model looks sensitive above 4k tokens in the eval traces.

ryan: Agree. Proposal: run three parallel probes: 1) int8 per-channel, 2) fp8 group-wise, 3) gguf hybrid (int8 kvcache + fp8 attention) to measure tradeoffs. Keep sample sizes small first (~1k) then scale to 5k for winners.

sofia: Important to include the multi-turn persona prompts in calibration set (we saw prior regen issues when conditioning carries). add prompt types: assistant-only, persona+user, long-system.

alex: Quick starter config I used for a different 13B — paste for reference:

```yaml
calib_run:
  model: hermes-13b-long
  precisions: [int8, fp8, gguf-hybrid]
  context_buckets: [512, 2048, 8192]
  calib_samples_per_bucket: 1000
  per_channel: true
  eval_metrics: [ppl, rouge, embedding_drift_cosine]
  acceptance_thresholds:
    max_ppl_increase_pct: 3
    max_embedding_drift_cosine_drop: 0.02
```

jia: perfect — can we add a quick command to run the probe on dev infra?

ryan: run this locally against a small shard then schedule on dedicated pool:
`./calib_tool --model hermes-13b-long --precisions int8,fp8 --buckets 512,2048,8192 --samples 1000 --out /tmp/hermes_calib.json`

quant-bot: heads-up: int8 per-channel runs ~0.55x baseline cost on p4d, fp8 ~0.65x but p95 latency increases ~12% on 8k context when using raw kernels.

margaret: ok, so cost favors int8 but latency/p95 hit for long contexts. propose: int8 for short/medium routes (<=2048), fp8 or hybrid for >2048 to keep p95 SLOs.

sofia: agreed. Also suggest we add embedding-drift gating for reranker/semantic routes — if cosine <0.98, fallback to fp8. simple rule in console.

alex: can we capture a minimal eval checklist for the release note?

jia: Draft checklist:
- collect calibration samples (balanced by bucket and prompt type)
- run int8/fp8/gguf-hybrid probes (1k -> 5k)
- compute metrics: ppl, rouge, sacrebleu (if retrieval), embedding cosine vs FP32 baseline
- check generation quality on 200 curated prompts (SMOKE) across contexts
- latency/cost matrix per precision and context bucket (p50/p95, tokens/sec, unit $/k tokens)
- set routing policy: int8 <=2048, hybrid 2048-4096, fp8 >4096 (tunable)
- canary rollout on Dedicated (5% traffic) -> monitor errors, perplexity, embedding drift, token cost

ryan: thresholds we used previously that worked: ppl increase <3%, rouge drop <1.5 points, embedding cosine >= 0.98, p95 latency increase <15% vs baseline. use those unless QA objects.

margaret: who owns the canary dashboard? I can take first pass on alerts (embedding drift, regression count, latency p95).

jia: awesome — marge you're owner. alex can do the smoke generation harness. sofia to assemble calibration prompt sets. ryan to drive the initial runs and upload artifacts. i'll open the onboarding ticket and attach this plan.

deploy-bot: New ticket created: #ONB-1472 — hermes-13b-long quant plan. Assigned: marge, alex, sofia, ryan. Priority: P2.

sofia: one more note — include safety token patterns in the smoke set; some models change tokenization behavior under quant.

ria: (typo) sorry ignore last

margaret: :thumbsup: I'll get alerts wired and start the 1k probes tomorrow. posting progress in this thread.

jia: thanks everyone. tagging infra if we need extra `dedicated` capacity later. :rocket:
